☾
Mission science & sources

Each turn represents one Earth day. Resource points, solar charging, events and outcome thresholds are simplified game rules. Safety measures readiness and protection. This fictional outpost uses stored meals and an established crop experiment.

NASA’s Diviner instrument maps lunar surface temperatures. These measurements inform the cold-operation scenario. This prototype uses qualitative science explanations and does not yet include extracted numerical NASA data.

  • LRO Diviner temperature archive
  • NASA air and water life support
  • Orion crew protection
  • NASA growing plants in space
